name: Vale of Giant Flowers
title: Vale of Giant Flowers
summary: A valley of giant flowers from another world in the Mid Direlands. Acpedia traces it from 26.0S 75.0W south, then east to the Valley of Death and past the Renegade Fortress. The kit has only six giant flowers at the start point but 86 in the meadow west and south-west of the Renegade Fortress: purple 0x020004C1 blooms 10-26 m tall, among giant grass. The site is anchored in that meadow (about 29.3S 66.4W), 210 m west of the fortress's earth wall, where the flowers are 'found in vast numbers'.

site.name: Vale of Giant Flowers
site.notes: Derived @teleloc in the flower meadow at (8545,17420), ground 0, 8 m from the nearest grass tuft. The gazetteer has only a map @tele at the 26.0S 75.0W start point.

insertNote: Kept the batch's route position (fort-tethana -> ayan-baqur).

shots.standingOrder: Glide east-south-east 30 m above the vale, just over the giant purple flower heads, toward the tallest bloom under the Renegade Fortress wall; never below 20 m above the meadow.
shots.notes: Signature view of the vale: the drone glides east-south-east 70 m at 7 m/s, 30 m above the meadow and just over the heads of the giant purple flowers (10-26 m tall, 54 in this landblock). It flies toward the tallest bloom under the 90 m earth wall of the Renegade Fortress (subject centred). The late sun is behind the lens. It is placed where acpedia says the flowers grow 'in vast numbers around the outside of the Valley of Death ... past the Renegade Fortress', not at the acpedia start point 26.0S 75.0W, where the kit shows only six flowers.
